text:
jon: Deploy-bot paused the promotion. Staging canaries failing on artifact pushes; multipart uploads keep timing out and the shared cache is experiencing a write storm leading to MRU evictions.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_write_backpressure).

jon: Uploader snippets:
```
chunk write failed: timeout after 30s
registry: 503 slow_down x 28
cache-shard-3: queue_depth=820, evictions=high
```

lucy: This looks like the cache mirror is saturated. Quick mitigations: reduce multipart concurrency, switch registry endpoint to eu-west fallback, or pin to last-known-good image and rerun CI.

release-coordinator: Change window in ~45m. Pinning seems safest to avoid mid-window rollback. Recommend pin + clear note in release notes.

jon: Created pin PR: https://deploybot/internal/pins/2854321999  pinned sha256:7f12a9c4. Also lowered uploader concurrency to 3 for the retry.

ci-bot: Rerun queued on pinned image: pipeline #5049 (staged).

infra-oncall: Investigating shard-3. Observed many small writes amplified by concurrent chunk uploads. Starting a temporary scale-up of the shard group and increasing the write buffer. Will report back in ~8m.

lucy: I'll update release notes: "Promo held - pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact upload backpressure; infra investigating cache shard drain." Marking cut as "held - pinned".

jon: If infra stabilizes within the window we can unpin and proceed; otherwise we keep the pin and move the promotion to the next window. Posting updates to #release-updates.

infra-oncall: Quick update: scaled shard group and bumped buffer; queue depth dropping and 503s decreasing. Recommend waiting 6m for stability before deciding.
